findings.passage: “In Congress, I will help lead the fight to secure our elections,” Pino said in a statement this week. “We need mandatory Voter ID nationwide and strict limits on late mail-in voting."
findings.note: Quoted by AP in its story on her primary win; statement issued in her name after the primary. Calls for a nationwide voter ID requirement and limits on late mail-in voting.
